<section>
<div class="StoryCardRow ContentSection row" id="StoryCardMain">
<div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6 col-xl-3 StoryCardCol">
<div class="card HomePageCard h-100">
<div class="Icon">
<svg class="SVGColor" style="fill:#000" viewbox="-75 0 300 160" x="0px" y="0px">
</svg>
</div>
<img alt="" class="card-img-top" src="/portals/84/Images/StoryCard/Colors.png" style="width:100%;"/>
<div class="card-block" style="padding-left: 10px; padding-right: 10px;">
<h2 class="card-title">
            Gifted and Talented Testing
          </h2>
<div class="card-text StoryCardText">
<p>The fall online application is ready for parents who wish to have their child tested for the Gifted and Talented Program in CCISD.  CCISD students in grades 1-12 will be tested  during the testing window of September 30 - October 11, 2019. <a href="https://gtapplication.ccisd.us/">Complete application here</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6 col-xl-3 StoryCardCol">
<div class="card HomePageCard h-100">
<div class="Icon">
<svg class="SVGColor" style="fill:#000" viewbox="-75 0 300 160" x="0px" y="0px">
</svg>
</div>
<img alt="" class="card-img-top" src="/portals/84/Images/StoryCard/Calendar_Card_450x250px.png" style="width:100%;"/>
<div class="card-block" style="padding-left: 10px; padding-right: 10px;">
<h2 class="card-title">
            Registration Now Open for Returning Students
          </h2>
<div class="card-text StoryCardText">
<p>Registration is now open for returning students. The first day of school for the 2019-2020 school year is Monday, August 26th. The instructional day for elementary schools is 7:50 a.m. to 3:05 p.m. The instructional day for middle and high schools is 8:50 a.m. to 4:05 p.m.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6 col-xl-3 StoryCardCol">
<div class="card HomePageCard h-100">

<h2 class="card-title">
               CCISD Implements Clear Bag Policy
            </h2>
<div class="card-text AnnouncementText">
<p>As part of its work to continually improve district safety and security for students, staff and visitors, CCISD is implementing a clear-bag requirement for all athletic events at Cabaniss Sports Complex and Buccaneer Stadium, starting the 2019-2020 school year <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XLdszxshVbeeIOP2KSP5KGaO5t2rZj1q/view?usp=sharing" target="_blank">Clear bag information</a></p>

            </h2>
<div class="card-text AnnouncementText">
<p>Students who are new to CCISD may complete the online registration.
